NASB.1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NASB.2: 'Speak to Aaron and say to him, 'When you mount the lamps, the seven lamps will give light in the front of the lampstand.''
NASB.3: Aaron therefore did so; he mounted its lamps at the front of the lampstand, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NASB.4: Now this was the workmanship of the lampstand, hammered work of gold; from its base to its flowers it was hammered work; according to the pattern which the LORD had showed Moses, so he made the lampstand.
NASB.5: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NASB.6: 'Take the Levites from among the sons of Israel and cleanse them.
NASB.7: 'Thus you shall do to them, for their cleansing: [sprinkle] purifying water on them, and let them use a razor over their whole body and wash their clothes, and they will be clean.
NASB.8: 'Then let them take a bull with its grain offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and a second bull you shall take for a sin offering.
NASB.9: 'So you shall present the Levites before the tent of meeting. You shall also assemble the whole congregation of the sons of Israel,
NASB.10: and present the Levites before the LORD; and the sons of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites.
NASB.11: 'Aaron then shall present the Levites before the LORD as a wave offering from the sons of Israel, that they may qualify to perform the service of the LORD.
NASB.12: 'Now the Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls; then offer the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering to the LORD, to make atonement for the Levites.
NASB.13: 'You shall have the Levites stand before Aaron and before his sons so as to present them as a wave offering to the LORD.
NASB.14: 'Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the sons of Israel, and the Levites shall be Mine.
NASB.15: 'Then after that the Levites may go in to serve the tent of meeting. But you shall cleanse them and present them as a wave offering;
NASB.16: for they are wholly given to Me from among the sons of Israel. I have taken them for Myself instead of every first issue of the womb, the firstborn of all the sons of Israel.
NASB.17: 'For every firstborn among the sons of Israel is Mine, among the men and among the animals; on the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for Myself.
NASB.18: 'But I have taken the Levites instead of every firstborn among the sons of Israel.
NASB.19: 'I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the sons of Israel, to perform the service of the sons of Israel at the tent of meeting and to make atonement on behalf of the sons of Israel, so that there will be no plague among the sons of Israel by their coming near to the sanctuary.'
NASB.20: Thus did Moses and Aaron and all the congregation of the sons of Israel to the Levites; according to all that the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the sons of Israel did to them.
NASB.21: The Levites, too, purified themselves from sin and washed their clothes; and Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the LORD. Aaron also made atonement for them to cleanse them.
NASB.22: Then after that the Levites went in to perform their service in the tent of meeting before Aaron and before his sons; just as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.
NASB.23: Now the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NASB.24: 'This is what [applies] to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall enter to perform service in the work of the tent of meeting.
NASB.25: 'But at the age of fifty years they shall retire from service in the work and not work any more.
NASB.26: 'They may, however, assist their brothers in the tent of meeting, to keep an obligation, but they [themselves] shall do no work. Thus you shall deal with the Levites concerning their obligations.'

ESV.1: Now the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
ESV.2: “Speak to Aaron and say to him, When you set up the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lampstand.”
ESV.3: And Aaron did so: he set up its lamps in front of the lampstand, as the LORD commanded Moses.
ESV.4: And this was the workmanship of the lampstand, hammered work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was hammered work; according to the pattern that the LORD had shown Moses, so he made the lampstand.
ESV.5: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
ESV.6: “Take the Levites from among the people of Israel and cleanse them.
ESV.7: Thus you shall do to them to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of purification upon them, and let them go with a razor over all their body, and wash their clothes and cleanse themselves.
ESV.8: Then let them take a bull from the herd and its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, and you shall take another bull from the herd for a sin offering.
ESV.9: And you shall bring the Levites before the tent of meeting and assemble the whole congregation of the people of Israel.
ESV.10: When you bring the Levites before the LORD, the people of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites,
ESV.11: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD as a wave offering from the people of Israel, that they may do the service of the LORD.
ESV.12: Then the Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and you shall offer the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering to the LORD to make atonement for the Levites.
ESV.13: And you shall set the Levites before Aaron and his sons, and shall offer them as a wave offering to the LORD.
ESV.14: “Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the people of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.
ESV.15: And after that the Levites shall go in to serve at the tent of meeting, when you have cleansed them and offered them as a wave offering.
ESV.16: For they are wholly given to me from among the people of Israel. Instead of all who open the womb, the firstborn of all the people of Israel, I have taken them for myself.
ESV.17: For all the firstborn among the people of Israel are mine, both of man and of beast. On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I consecrated them for myself,
ESV.18: and I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the people of Israel.
ESV.19: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and his sons from among the people of Israel, to do the service for the people of Israel at the tent of meeting and to make atonement for the people of Israel, that there may be no plague among the people of Israel when the people of Israel come near the sanctuary.”
ESV.20: Thus did Moses and Aaron and all the congregation of the people of Israel to the Levites. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, the people of Israel did to them.
ESV.21: And the Levites purified themselves from sin and washed their clothes, and Aaron offered them as a wave offering before the LORD, and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.
ESV.22: And after that the Levites went in to do their service in the tent of meeting before Aaron and his sons; as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.
ESV.23: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
ESV.24: “This applies to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they  shall come to do duty in the service of the tent of meeting.
ESV.25: And from the age of fifty years they shall withdraw from the duty of the service and serve no more.
ESV.26: They minister  to their brothers in the tent of meeting by keeping guard, but they shall do no service. Thus shall you do to the Levites in assigning their duties.”

NKJV.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
NKJV.2: “Speak to Aaron, and say to him, ‘When you arrange the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lampstand.’ ”
NKJV.3: And Aaron did so; he arranged the lamps to face toward the front of the lampstand, as the LORD commanded Moses.
NKJV.4: Now this workmanship of the lampstand was hammered gold; from its shaft to its flowers it was hammered work. According to the pattern which the LORD had shown Moses, so he made the lampstand.
NKJV.5: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
NKJV.6: “Take the Levites from among the children of Israel and cleanse them ceremonially.
NKJV.7: Thus you shall do to them to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purification on them, and let them shave all their body, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.
NKJV.8: Then let them take a young bull with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, and you shall take another young bull as a sin offering.
NKJV.9: And you shall bring the Levites before the tabernacle of meeting, and you shall gather together the whole congregation of the children of Israel.
NKJV.10: So you shall bring the Levites before the LORD, and the children of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites;
NKJV.11: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD like a wave offering from the children of Israel, that they may perform the work of the LORD.
NKJV.12: Then the Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the young bulls, and you shall offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to the LORD, to make atonement for the Levites.
NKJV.13: “And you shall stand the Levites before Aaron and his sons, and then offer them like a wave offering to the LORD.
NKJV.14: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be Mine.
NKJV.15: After that the Levites shall go in to service the tabernacle of meeting. So you shall cleanse them and offer them like a wave offering.
NKJV.16: For they are wholly given to Me from among the children of Israel; I have taken them for Myself instead of all who open the womb, the firstborn of all the children of Israel.
NKJV.17: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are Mine, both man and beast; on the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them to Myself.
NKJV.18: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn of the children of Israel.
NKJV.19: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the work for the children of Israel in the tabernacle of meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel, that there be no plague among the children of Israel when the children of Israel come near the sanctuary.”
NKJV.20: Thus Moses and Aaron and all the congregation of the children of Israel did to the Levites; according to all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.
NKJV.21: And the Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes; then Aaron presented them like a wave offering before the LORD, and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.
NKJV.22: After that the Levites went in to do their work in the tabernacle of meeting before Aaron and his sons; as the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.
NKJV.23: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NKJV.24: “This is what pertains to the Levites: From twenty-five years old and above one may enter to perform service in the work of the tabernacle of meeting;
NKJV.25: and at the age of fifty years they must cease performing this work, and shall work no more.
NKJV.26: They may minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of meeting, to attend to needs, but they themselves shall do no work. Thus you shall do to the Levites regarding their duties.”

NLT.2: “Give Aaron the following instructions: When you set up the seven lamps in the lampstand, place them so their light shines forward in front of the lampstand.”
NLT.3: So Aaron did this. He set up the seven lamps so they reflected their light forward, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NLT.4: The entire lampstand, from its base to its decorative blossoms, was made of beaten gold. It was built according to the exact design the LORD had shown Moses.
NLT.5: Then the LORD said to Moses,
NLT.6: “Now set the Levites apart from the rest of the people of Israel and make them ceremonially clean.
NLT.7: Do this by sprinkling them with the water of purification, and have them shave their entire body and wash their clothing. Then they will be ceremonially clean.
NLT.8: Have them bring a young bull and a grain offering of choice flour moistened with olive oil, along with a second young bull for a sin offering.
NLT.9: Then assemble the whole community of Israel, and present the Levites at the entrance of the Tabernacle.
NLT.10: When you present the Levites before the LORD, the people of Israel must lay their hands on them.
NLT.11: Raising his hands, Aaron must then present the Levites to the LORD as a special offering from the people of Israel, thus dedicating them to the LORD’s service.
NLT.12: “Next the Levites will lay their hands on the heads of the young bulls. Present one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to the LORD, to purify the Levites and make them right with the LORD.
NLT.13: Then have the Levites stand in front of Aaron and his sons, and raise your hands and present them as a special offering to the LORD.
NLT.14: In this way, you will set the Levites apart from the rest of the people of Israel, and the Levites will belong to me.
NLT.15: After this, they may go into the Tabernacle to do their work, because you have purified them and presented them as a special offering.
NLT.16: “Of all the people of Israel, the Levites are reserved for me. I have claimed them for myself in place of all the firstborn sons of the Israelites; I have taken the Levites as their substitutes.
NLT.17: For all the firstborn males among the people of Israel are mine, both of people and of animals. I set them apart for myself on the day I struck down all the firstborn sons of the Egyptians.
NLT.18: Yes, I have claimed the Levites in place of all the firstborn sons of Israel.
NLT.19: And of all the Israelites, I have assigned the Levites to Aaron and his sons. They will serve in the Tabernacle on behalf of the Israelites and make sacrifices to purify the people so no plague will strike them when they approach the sanctuary.”
NLT.20: So Moses, Aaron, and the whole community of Israel dedicated the Levites, carefully following all the LORD’s instructions to Moses.
NLT.21: The Levites purified themselves from sin and washed their clothes, and Aaron lifted them up and presented them to the LORD as a special offering. He then offered a sacrifice to purify them and make them right with the LORD.
NLT.22: After that the Levites went into the Tabernacle to perform their duties, assisting Aaron and his sons. So they carried out all the commands that the LORD gave Moses concerning the Levites.
NLT.24: “This is the rule the Levites must follow: They must begin serving in the Tabernacle at the age of twenty-five,
NLT.25: and they must retire at the age of fifty.
NLT.26: After retirement they may assist their fellow Levites by serving as guards at the Tabernacle, but they may not officiate in the service. This is how you must assign duties to the Levites.”

WEB.2: “Speak to Aaron, and tell him, ‘When you light the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lamp stand.’”
WEB.3: Aaron did so. He lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lamp stand, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
WEB.4: This was the workmanship of the lamp stand, beaten work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was beaten work: according to the pattern which Yahweh had shown Moses, so he made the lamp stand.
WEB.6: “Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
WEB.7: You shall do this to them, to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies with a razor, and let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.
WEB.8: Then let them take a young bull, and its meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and another young bull you shall take for a sin offering.
WEB.9: You shall present the Levites before the Tent of Meeting. You shall assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel.
WEB.10: You shall present the Levites before Yahweh. The children of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites,
WEB.11: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before Yahweh for a wave offering, on the behalf of the children of Israel, that it may be theirs to do the service of Yahweh.
WEB.12: “The Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and you shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering to Yahweh, to make atonement for the Levites.
WEB.13: You shall set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them as a wave offering to Yahweh.
WEB.14: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.
WEB.15: “After that, the Levites shall go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting: and you shall cleanse them, and offer them as a wave offering.
WEB.16: For they are wholly given to me from among the children of Israel; instead of all who open the womb, even the firstborn of all the children of Israel, I have taken them to me.
WEB.17: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are mine, both man and animal. On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for myself.
WEB.18: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
WEB.19: I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel; that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come near to the sanctuary.”
WEB.20: Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel did so to the Levites. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.
WEB.21: The Levites purified themselves from sin, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them for a wave offering before Yahweh; and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.
WEB.22: After that, the Levites went in to do their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron, and before his sons: as Yahweh had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.
WEB.24: “This is that which belongs to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall go in to wait on the service in the work of the Tent of Meeting;
WEB.25: and from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting on the work, and shall serve no more,
WEB.26: but shall minister with their brothers in the Tent of Meeting, to perform the duty, and shall do no service. You shall do thus to the Levites concerning their duties.”

CSB17.2: “Speak to Aaron and tell him: When you set up the lamps, the seven lamps are to give light in front of the lampstand.”
CSB17.3: So Aaron did this; he set up its lamps to give light in front of the lampstand just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
CSB17.4: This is the way the lampstand was made: it was a hammered work of gold, hammered from its base to its flower petals. The lampstand was made according to the pattern the LORD had shown Moses. <sup>ⓑ</sup>
CSB17.6: “Take the Levites from among the Israelites and ceremonially cleanse them.
CSB17.7: Do this to them for their purification: Sprinkle them with the purification water. <sup>ⓒ</sup> Have them shave their entire bodies and wash their clothes, and so purify themselves. <sup>ⓓ</sup>
CSB17.8: “They are to take a young bull and its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, and you are to take a second young bull for a sin offering.
CSB17.9: Bring the Levites before the tent of meeting and assemble the entire Israelite community. <sup>ⓔ</sup>
CSB17.10: Then present the Levites before the LORD, and have the Israelites lay their hands on them.
CSB17.11: Aaron is to present the Levites before the LORD as a presentation offering from the Israelites, so that they may perform the LORD’s work. <sup>ⓕ</sup>
CSB17.12: Next the Levites are to lay their hands on the heads of the bulls. Sacrifice one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to the LORD, to make atonement for the Levites. <sup>ⓖ</sup>
CSB17.13: “You are to have the Levites stand before Aaron and his sons, and you are to present them before the LORD as a presentation offering.

CSB17.15: After that the Levites may come to serve at the tent of meeting, once you have ceremonially cleansed them and presented them as a presentation offering. <sup>ⓘ</sup>
CSB17.16: For they have been exclusively assigned to me from the Israelites. <sup>ⓙ</sup> I have taken them for myself in place of all who come first from the womb, every Israelite firstborn. <sup>ⓚ</sup>
CSB17.17: For every firstborn among the Israelites is mine, both man and animal. I consecrated them to myself <sup>ⓛ</sup> on the day I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt.

CSB17.21: The Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes; then Aaron presented <sup>[1]</sup> them before the LORD as a presentation offering. Aaron also made atonement for them to cleanse them ceremonially.
CSB17.22: After that, the Levites came to do their work at the tent of meeting in the presence of Aaron and his sons. So they did to them as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites.
CSB17.24: “In regard to the Levites: From twenty-five years old or more, a man enters the service in the work at the tent of meeting. <sup>ⓝ</sup>
CSB17.25: But at fifty years old he is to retire from his service in the work and no longer serve.
CSB17.26: He may assist his brothers to fulfill responsibilities <sup>[2]</sup> at the tent of meeting, <sup>ⓐ</sup> but he must not do the work. This is how you are to deal with the Levites regarding their duties.”

AMP.1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
AMP.2: "Speak to Aaron and say to him, 'When you set up and light the lamps, the seven lamps will shine in front of the lampstand.'"
AMP.3: And Aaron did so; he set up the lamps at the front of the lampstand, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
AMP.4: Now this was the workmanship of the lampstand: hammered work of gold; from its base to its flowers it was hammered work; according to the pattern which the LORD had shown Moses, so he made the lampstand.
AMP.5: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
AMP.6: "Take the Levites from among the sons of Israel and cleanse them.
AMP.7: This is what you shall do to them to [ceremonially] cleanse them: sprinkle the water of purification on them, and let them use a razor over their whole body and wash their clothes, and they will be clean.
AMP.8: Then let them take a young bull and its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, and you shall take another young bull as a sin offering.
AMP.9: You shall present the Levites before the Tent of Meeting (tabernacle), and you shall also assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel,
AMP.10: and present the Levites before the LORD, and the Israelites shall lay their hands on the Levites.
AMP.11: "Aaron shall present the Levites before the LORD as a wave offering from the Israelites, so that they may perform the service of the LORD.
AMP.12: Then the Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, then you are to offer the one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to the LORD, to make atonement for the Levites.
AMP.13: You shall have the Levites stand before Aaron and his sons and present them as a wave offering to the LORD.
AMP.14: "Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the Israelites, and the Levites shall be Mine [in a very special sense].
AMP.15: Then after that the Levites may go in to serve the Tent of Meeting (tabernacle), but you shall cleanse them [first] and present them as a wave offering;
AMP.16: for they are wholly given to Me from among the Israelites. I have taken them for Myself instead of all who are born first, the firstborn of all the Israelites.
AMP.17: For all the firstborn among the Israelites are Mine, among the men and among the animals; on the day that I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified and set the Israelites apart for Myself.
AMP.18: And I have taken the Levites instead of every firstborn among the Israelites.
AMP.19: I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the Israelites, to perform the service of the Israelites at the Tent of Meeting (tabernacle) and to make atonement for them, so that there will be no plague among the Israelites if they should approach the sanctuary."
AMP.20: Thus Moses and Aaron and all the congregation of the children of Israel did [these things] to the Levites; in accordance with all that the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the Israelites did to them.
AMP.21: The Levites, too, purified themselves from sin and they washed their clothes; and Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the LORD, and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.
AMP.22: Then after that the Levites went in to perform their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron and his sons; just as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.
AMP.23: Now the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
AMP.24: "This is what applies to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall enter to perform service in the work of the Tent of Meeting,
AMP.25: but at the age of fifty years, they shall retire from the service of the [tabernacle] work and serve no longer.
AMP.26: They may assist their brothers in the Tent of Meeting to keep an obligation, but they shall do no [heavy or difficult] work. Thus you shall deal with the Levites concerning their obligations."

NIV.1:

NIV.2: “Speak to Aaron and say to him, ‘When you set up the seven lamps, they are to light the area in front of the lampstand.’”

The Setting Apart of the Levites
The Lord said to Moses:
NIV.6: “Take the Levites from among the other Israelites and make them ceremonially clean.
